worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.summary: Hold the skill key to reach out a thick drain-root aimed along your aim: over a fixed number of waves it checks the real first contact along the current aiming line. Only a wave whose first contact is a valid enemy deals damage and returns half of it to the user. Walls and allies break the line, and aiming at empty ground only draws dry; the wave count is fixed, so releasing, being interrupted or running out of waves retracts the root at once. A moving target can be kept drained by continuing to track it.
Each wave deals about %1$s special damage; it checks %2$s wave(s) in all, one every %3$s s, and a wave only settles when its real first contact is a valid enemy.
The root reaches %1$s blocks; each wave checks a line that long along your current aim.
%1$s of each wave's real damage is restored to the user.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.deepPour.on: Deep pour: two heavy waves, a thicker root and a fiercer draw, but slower, longer cooldown and easier to interrupt.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.deepPour.off: Three light waves: more total healing and a faster rhythm for staying in the fight.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.growth.0: From level %1$s each wave rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.growth.1: From level %1$s each wave rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s and the waves to %4$s.
While held, the root keeps aiming: every wave re-reads the current aim and the real first contact on that line, so a moving target can be followed by turning the aim. A wall or an ally breaks that wave. Releasing, being interrupted or running out of waves retracts the root at once; remaining waves are not made up.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.use.0: Keep one target's life draining from across the field
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.use.1: Pull a health line back over several waves when it is running low
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.use.2: Track a moving heavy target, draining and healing at the same time
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.preference.d: On: two heavy waves, a thicker root and a fiercer draw, but slower, longer cooldown and easier to interrupt. Off: three light waves with more total healing and a faster rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than reaching out. Larger opens from further away.
When the target is closer than this, the user values the ranged draw less and prefers to keep its spacing; larger keeps it out of point-blank range, smaller lets it aim from close up.
Below this health ratio the user prefers giga drain as sustain; higher spends the long cooldown sooner.
On: only spend this move below the heal threshold, saving the long cooldown for sustain. Off: treat it as an ordinary ranged heavy even at full health.
